changes: Added a Casino Pot fine system, on top of the existing 15% burn: a losing Group Multi leg fines the pot 250,000 XP (symmetric with Undo Week), and every individual wrong AFL tip fines the pot 150,000 XP via a new scheduled check. Both come straight out of the shared pot, never a personal balance.
Added a Casino Pot burn: 15% of every pot is now permanently removed rather than paid out, so the numbers stop only ever growing.

The stale legacy Casino Pot entry kept resurfacing in a couple more places: "Your Recent Activity" and the Home tab's "big wins this week" feed. Both now filter it out the same way the Floor feed already did.
Closed a real eligibility loophole: winning a Casino Pot share was itself counting as "real XP" toward qualifying for the NEXT period too, even with zero plays.
